name: Classroom Chalkboard

background.description: Dark green-black board gradient with SVG feTurbulence smudges at 6% opacity, faint horizontal eraser streaks, and a hand-drawn chalk border (dashed, slightly wobbly SVG stroke) inside the safe area
background.motion: very subtle chalk-dust specks floating, 25s loop

timer.tickEffect: chalk line is erased from right to left, shakes and turns red-chalk on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: eraser wipe clears the options, then the correct answer is circled in yellow chalk with a draw-on stroke
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: smudged out and faded to 25% opacity

music.mood: light jazzy classroom piano with brushed drums, 100 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 11:1; lime correct is much brighter than coral-red wrong

name: Glass Aurora

background.description: Violet gradient with four large blurred blobs (cyan, pink, orange, blue, 400-600px, blur 80px) behind frosted cards using backdrop-filter blur(24px) and a 1px white 30% border
background.motion: blobs drift and morph slowly, 25s loop

timer.tickEffect: thick frosted ring with a cyan glow drains clockwise and brightens on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: glass card flips to a mint-tinted face with a soft glow and a check icon
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: cards blur out and fade to 25% opacity

music.mood: smooth modern electronic with airy pads, 105 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 7:1 worst case with blobs behind the card; keep a dark tint behind long text

name: Comic Pop

background.description: Yellow gradient with a red halftone dot pattern (radial-gradient dots, 24px grid, fading toward the center) and bold black 6px outlines on cards with hard offset shadows

timer.tickEffect: number sits in a red starburst that pops bigger every second and shakes on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: screen shake with a 'POW!' burst and the correct card turning deep green
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options get a 'NOPE' cross and fade to 30% opacity

music.mood: quirky brassy cartoon swing, 125 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 11:1; dark green correct vs bright pink wrong differ strongly in brightness, so keep the icons

name: Misty Forest

background.description: Dark green vertical gradient with pale mist bands (blurred white gradients at 8% opacity), glowing yellow firefly dots, and layered pine-tree silhouettes as SVG polygons along the bottom
background.motion: fireflies float and blink, mist drifts sideways, 22s loop

timer.tickEffect: a vine-like green bar shrinks, leaves wiggle, and it turns amber on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: correct answer slides to center with a light-ray glow and a leaf badge
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options slide out sideways and fade to 25% opacity

music.mood: gentle acoustic nature folk with soft flute, 98 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 10:1 at the lighter stop; lime correct is far brighter than orange-red wrong

name: Arctic Ice

background.description: Pale icy blue gradient with large translucent white crystal facets (CSS clip-path polygons at 20-40% opacity) and tiny sparkle stars that fade in and out
background.motion: facets shift slightly, sparkles twinkle, 16s loop

timer.tickEffect: an ice slab melts from right to left, with drips and a color shift to violet on the last 3

reveal.correctEffect: diagonal shine sweeps across the correct card, which turns deep teal with a glint
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options frost over and fade to 30% opacity

music.mood: bright airy piano with bells and light beat, 108 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 11:1; deep teal correct vs light pink-red wrong differ clearly in brightness

name: Candy Pop

background.description: Pink-to-lilac gradient with soft diagonal candy stripes (repeating-linear-gradient in white at 35% opacity) and large lollipop swirl circles made from conic-gradients in the corners
background.motion: stripes scroll slowly, swirls rotate, 12s loop

timer.tickEffect: candy-striped ring drains clockwise and bounces on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: sprinkle confetti burst and the correct card turns deep green with a sparkle
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options squish slightly and fade to 30% opacity

music.mood: bubbly bouncy pop with xylophone and claps, 118 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 8:1; dark green correct vs bright coral wrong differ strongly in brightness

name: Gold Luxury

background.description: Black to dark bronze gradient with thin gold art-deco line patterns (SVG repeating diamonds at 8% opacity), a gold 2px frame, and a diagonal metallic shimmer sweep
background.motion: shimmer passes across the frame every 6s

timer.tickEffect: gold sand falls through a thin hourglass, glow intensifies on the last 3 seconds

reveal.correctEffect: gold sparkle burst with the correct card scaling up and a green check seal
reveal.wrongOptionEffect: options dim to 25% opacity and lose their gold border

music.mood: cinematic orchestral game-show suspense with strings and timpani, 100 bpm, no vocals

contrastNote: text on bg ≈ 17:1; bright green correct is much lighter than ruby wrong
